result.title: Curvature-Equilibrated Policy Optimization for Deep Reinforcement Learning
result.summary: Gradient-based actor optimization is central to deep reinforcement learning. However, conventional first-order optimizers do not explicitly exploit the local curvature of neural actor losses. We propose EQUIP (Curvature-Equilibrated Gradients for Policy Search), a novel approach that seeks to balance local contraction and expansion of the actor parameter space by equilibrating positive and negative curvature. EQUIP constructs a trajectory-informed search subspace and uses the projected Hessian of actor loss to build a bounded local metric for curvature equilibration. First-order loss matching preserves the approximated first-order decrease in actor loss. Meanwhile, gradient mixing and curvature-based gradient selection adjust the gradient applied for actor optimization. We establish the geometric properties of curvature equilibration, derive bounds on gradient alignment and magnitude, and identify conditions for improved actor loss reduction and convergence toward stationarity under direct gradient updates. We integrate EQUIP into Soft Actor-Critic (SAC) without modifying its actor loss, critic learning, or replay mechanism. Experiments on 6 MuJoCo continuous control benchmarks show that the resulting EQUIP-SAC algorithm achieves higher mean sample efficiency than SAC and two second-order policy optimization baselines. Ablation studies further highlight the benefits of curvature equilibration and trajectory-informed geometry for policy training.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 EQUIP：用轨迹信息构造搜索子空间，以投影 Hessian 建立有界局部度量来平衡正负曲率，并配合梯度混合与曲率筛选调整 actor 更新，集成进 SAC 在 6 个 MuJoCo 连续控制任务上验证样本效率。
AI.relevance_reason: 其曲率均衡的二阶式策略梯度更新，可能可供核查用于 latent 推理策略的 RL 训练稳定性与更新方向，但原文为连续控制设定，向 VLM 推理迁移的有效性尚未验证。
